## 中文

### 新增

- 支持通过对话创建和改进 Skill，将常用工作流程整理为可复用技能；安装前可校验并预览，由用户确认安装。
- 设置中新增内置提示词浏览，可只读查看系统提示词、执行模式、审批与附件规则，以及审查模板。
- 支持将超过 1500 字符或 20 行的粘贴文本转为附件，可预览并还原到输入框，也可在设置中关闭。
- 空间折叠时仍显示任务运行与等待确认状态。

### 改进

- 加快 Skills 设置页加载，支持手动刷新技能列表。
- 优化会话分支画布的缩放、拖动与缩略图导航，缩小视图时简化消息卡片，减少抖动。
- 更新窗口完整展示 Markdown 发布说明，保留标题、段落与链接。
- 优化资源面板与会话画布图标的显示效果。

### 修复

- 修复 Windows 沙盒组件被重复要求安装，以及安装完成后确认状态更新延迟的问题。
- 修复插件调用记录的展示与消息归属，以及条件检查期间状态变化引发的异常。

完整变更：[v0.10.0 → v0.10.1](https://github.com/useLexora/Lexora/compare/v0.10.0...v0.10.1)

## English

### Added

- Create and improve Skills through conversation to turn recurring workflows into reusable skills, with validation and a preview before user-confirmed installation.
- Browse built-in prompts in Settings, with read-only access to system prompts, execution modes, approval and attachment rules, and the review template.
- Paste text longer than 1,500 characters or 20 lines as an attachment. Preview it, restore it to the input, or turn this behavior off in Settings.
- See running tasks and pending approvals even when a Space is collapsed.

### Improved

- Faster loading of the Skills settings page, with manual refresh for the skill list.
- Smoother zooming, panning, and minimap navigation in the conversation branch canvas, with simplified message cards at smaller scales to reduce jitter.
- The update dialog displays full Markdown release notes, preserving headings, paragraphs, and links.
- Refined the appearance of resource panel and conversation canvas icons.

### Fixed

- Fixed repeated installation prompts for the Windows sandbox component and delayed status updates after installation.
- Fixed the display and message association of plugin call records, and errors caused by state changes during condition checks.

Full changelog: [v0.10.0 → v0.10.1](https://github.com/useLexora/Lexora/compare/v0.10.0...v0.10.1)
